question: settings
answer:
Three modules use `config.Settings` directly:

- [src/nvidia_ai/__main__.py](<work>/anvil-rules-official-codex/src/nvidia_ai/__main__.py:19) calls `Settings.from_env()` on the default CLI path. It uses `log_level` to configure logging and `env` in the startup message.
- [src/nvidia_ai/bench.py](<work>/anvil-rules-official-codex/src/nvidia_ai/bench.py:379) loads settings to configure the selected benchmark endpoints. It uses the NVIDIA base URL and requires an API key when NVIDIA is selected. It uses the Ollama base URL for the Ollama endpoint and to fetch version and model digest metadata.
- [tests/test_smoke.py](<work>/anvil-rules-official-codex/tests/test_smoke.py:12) clears `APP_ENV`, `LOG_LEVEL`, and `DATA_DIR`, then calls `Settings.from_env(dotenv=None)` to verify the defaults `dev`, `INFO`, and `data`.
